sn55.7:3.1: “Relevant for oneself” is attupanāyika, where upanāyika is a form of opaneyyika, a standard epithet of the Dhamma. The root sense is “leading near”, but here we see that the applied sense is “applicable to oneself”, i.e. “relevant”. See also Thag 1.1:1.4.
sn55.7:7.2: Here, in the context of false speech, attha means “meaning” rather than “welfare”.
